verses.text: Manh eyal esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail. Manh junnhejok tzeyutej he b'a yet' junok mach chuk spensar yik tzeyak'anoch he b'a testigoal t'a tas manh yelok.
Manh eyak'och he b'a yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh eyak'och he b'a testigoal t'a es yet' heb' anima sk'ulan chukal.
Wach'chom meb'a' junok anima, palta tato ay smul, manh eyak' och he b'a yet'ok.
Tato a junok winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex ay junok nok' swakax, ma nok' sb'uru satnakb'ati, tz'ilchaj nok' eyuuj, ik'ekb'at nok' t'a winh.
Yowalil tzex kolwaj t'a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayex. Tato tzeyila' to stelwi nok' sb'uru t'a yalanh yikatz, tzeyik'k'e waan nok' yet'ok.
Tato ay junok anima meb'a' snib'ej sch'olb'itaj yaj yowal, manh he tenek' t'ay.
Manh he cha junok esal lolonel t'a spatik junok anima. Manh eyak'och chamel t'a yib'anh junok anima malaj smul, yujto a in ol wak' spak t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Manh he cha k'een tumin t'a elk'altak yik tze b'oan yaj junok owal, yujto a yuj k'een tumin chi' tzeyak' musansatil he b'a, tze k'exankan tas tojol t'a tas manh tojolok.
Manh eyixtej anima ch'ok chonhab'il, yujto a ex tik najtil ix ex ek' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a Egipto. Eyojtakxo syaelal tz'utaj anima t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Wake' ab'il tzex munlaj t'a sat lum lum, tze molank'e sat tas tzeyawej.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, tzeyaktankan lu'um. Ha jantakto tastak sk'ib'k'e t'a sat lu'um, yikxo heb' meb'a' ayek' t'a yol he chonhab' chi' yet' nok' k'ultakil nok'. Wach'chom te' eyuwa ma te' eyolivo, manhxo he mesa'.

Wake' k'ualnhej tzex munlaji, haxo t'a yukil k'ual tzeyik'an eyip. Yet' pax nok' he wakax, nok' he b'uru yet' heb' he chekab' tz'alji t'a yol he cuenta yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il smunlaj heyet'ok syik'pax yip.
k'anab'ajejek masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayex. Manh eyal he b'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh he lokpax sb'i.
Oxel tzeyak'och k'inh t'a yol junjun ab'il yik tzin eyik'anchaanh.

Ha t'a uj Abib tzeyak'och sk'inhal ixim pan malaj yich, icha ix wutej walan t'ayex. T'a uke' k'ual tze wa ixim pan malaj yich, yujto ha t'a jun uj chi' ix ex elta t'a Egipto. Malajokab' junok mach sja t'a wichanh tato malaj jab'ok yofrenda yet'nak.
Tzeyak'anpaxoch k'inh ayik tz'elul sb'ab'el sat tas tzeyawej. Hanheja' tzeyak'anpaxoch junxo k'inh ayik slajwikank'e masanil sat tastak tzeyawej chi'.
Ha in Jehová he Yajalil in tik swala' to ha t'a oxe' k'inh chi' yowalil sjawi masanil heb' winh winak t'a wichanh.
Ayik tzeyak'an nok' nok' silab'il t'ayin, manh eyak'laj schik'il nok' yet' ixim pan ayb'at yich. Manh he sik'b'at xepual nok' silab' chi' t'a junokxo k'ual.
Ha wal sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en wach' tz'el t'a sat lum lum, ha' tzeyik'b'at t'a in kajnub', a in Jehová he Diosal in swala'. Manh he tz'anh nok' yunetak chiwa t'a skal yal yim snun.
Ol in chekb'at jun wángel t'a eyichanh yik wach' tzex tanhwaj yuj t'a yoltak b'e, ol ex yik'anb'at t'a jun lugar b'aj wach'xo yaj wuuj, b'aj ol ex ajok.
Scham wal heyilani, manh he pitej he b'a t'ay, palta tze k'anab'ajej tas syala'. Ichato ha' ol munlaj in k'exulok, manh ol ex yak'laj niwank'olal tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej t'ay.
Tato tze k'anab'ajej t'ay, tze k'ulan tas syal t'a in k'exulok, ol in och ajk'olal t'a mach ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex. Ol in och tek'tek' t'a yichanh mach snib'ej stek'b'ej sb'a t'a eyichanh.
Ha jun wángel chi' ol b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh. Ol ex yik'anb'at t'a sat lum sluum heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' cananeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo. Junelnhej ol in satkanel heb'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'a yichanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Manh ex empax kuman t'ay, manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' chonhab' chi' t'a eyik'anchaanh sdiosal heb'. Ha tas smoj tze k'ulej, to tze mak'poj sdiosal heb' chi' yet' masanil k'een k'een ayoch t'ay.
Ha innhej Jehová he Diosal in b'aj tzeyak'em he b'a. Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, ol wak' tas tze wa''a yet' tas tzeyuk'ej. Najat pax ol wik'el ilya t'a he kal.
Najat pax ol wutok he k 'inal. Ha t'a yol junjun he chonhab'il chi', malaj junok ix ix tonhej ol el yune', manh junok heb' ix to manh ol unewok.
Ol wak' xiwk'e sk'ol heb' anima tzex chakani. Ol wak' somchaj spensar heb' chonhab' tzeyak' owal yet'ok yet' masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayex, ol el lemnaj heb' t'ayex.
Ol wak' somchaj sk'ol heb' eyajk'ool yuj xiwelal ayik manto ex k'ochlaj, yuj chi' ol el lemnaj heb' heveo, heb' cananeo yet' pax heb' hitita t'ayex.
Manh junoknhej ab'il ol aj wik'anel heb' t'a eyichanh, yik wach' max ixtaxb'at lum lum yik manh ol te k'ib'pax sb'isul nok' k'ultakil nok' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayex.
k'ojank'olalnhej ol aj wik'anel heb' anima chi' t'a sat lu'um, masanto ayik ol k'ib' he b'isul, yik tze makan lum masanil.

Toxo ix wak'kanem stz'akanhil b'aj ol ek' lum he lu'um chi'. Schael yich b'aj ay ha' Chakchak Mar, masanto sk'och t'a ha' Éufrates, sb'atxonhej t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo, masanto t'a takinh lu'um. Ol wak'anoch heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um chi' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ha exxo ol he pechel heb' t'a sat lu'um chi'.
Manh wal he b'o junok he trato yet' heb', manh ex ochpax ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb'.

Manhxo pax he chakan heb' t'a yol he chonhab', yik wach' max ex skuchb'ej heb' he k'ulan chukal t'ayin. Tato tzeyak'em he b'a t'a sdiosal heb' chi', a ex wal tzeyixtejb'at he b'a syal chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
